name: exploratory
description: Exploratory workflow for research, prototyping, and learning. Tests are optional. Focus on understanding, experimentation, and spike work. Results may be throwaway code or inform future task planning.

subagent.description: Deep exploration required to understand codebase, libraries, or architectural decisions. Produce comprehensive findings for decision-making.

phase1_gather.description: Gather information from codebase, documentation, and external sources
objectives: Identify relevant files and code patterns
Research best practices and library options
phase1_gather.outputFormat: Structured list of findings with file references

phase2_analyze.description: Analyze gathered information and identify patterns

phase4_approve.description: Present findings and recommendations for approval
phase4_approve.presentationFormat: Executive summary with key findings, recommendation, and next steps

workflowSteps.name: Define Research Question
workflowSteps.description: Clarify what needs to be learned or prototyped

workflowSteps.name: Explore (Phase 1-3)
workflowSteps.description: Use Explore subagent to gather, analyze, and design

workflowSteps.name: Await Approval
workflowSteps.description: Get user approval on recommendations before proceeding
